children: Quantum X Labs says its 16-qubit algorithm reproduced photon transport through a tungsten collimator, with results closely aligned with analytical and classical simulations. The experiment did not implement amplitude estimation or establish an efficiency advantage over GPU-based methods.
Demonstrates accuracy on quantum hardware, but does not show a performance advantage over existing GPU-based methods.
The proposed route to reducing sampling effort remains untested; the release provides no demonstrated efficiency gain.
Each measurement point used 4,096 quantum shots
Provides an experimental sampling baseline; no comparable GPU sampling or compute figures were reported.

This is an early-stage technical demonstration, not evidence of commercial deployment or a demonstrated cost advantage. The next catalyst would be integrating amplitude estimation and benchmarking accuracy and computational performance against GPU-accelerated Monte Carlo methods.
